tool.name: nf-core proteinortho
tool.description: Proteinortho is a tool to detect orthologous genes within different species.
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ proteinortho \\ $args \\ -cpus=$task.cpus \\ -project=$prefix \\ $fasta_files
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": proteinortho : \$(echo \$(proteinortho --version 2>&1) ) \$(echo \$( "diamond:"(diamond version 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | sed 's/^.*version //;' ) || echo "") ) \$(echo \$( "blast:"(blastp -version 2>/dev/null |head -n1 | sed 's/^.*: //;' ) || echo "") ) \$(echo \$( "mmseqs:"(mmseqp version 2>/dev/null ) || echo "") ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Proteinortho is a tool to detect orthologous genes within different species.
**nf-core Module**
This tool is automatically generated from nf-core modules repository.
Module: proteinortho Container: ${ workflow.containerEngine ==
**More Information**
For more information about this tool, visit: https://github.com/nf-core/modules/tree/master/modules/nf-core/proteinortho ]]>
